# errdefer runs when a later deferred function literal starts unwinding after a
# successful return, by panic and by runtime.Goexit; it stays skipped on a plain
# success and when that literal returns normally, and recover() in the literal
# keeps its Go meaning. A later named-callee defer, a later literal with
# results, and a later literal that defers a call of its own each leave
# errdefer skipped when they panic after a successful return: the documented
# limit. The same holds in a comptime generic instance, which lowers on its
# own path.
# Native and ejected output must match. SPEC T-104.2.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m

logos run .
# One anchored semantic check: all required events, in order.
stdout '(?s)\Aplain ok: cleanup skipped\ndefer-second\ndefer-first\nstart-panic\nerrdefer-ran\nrecovered: late-boom\nstart-panic\nrecovered named: late-boom\nstart-panic\nrecovered result: late-boom\nstart-panic\ninner-deferred\nrecovered deferring: late-boom\nquiet-literal\nliteral-recovered: inner-boom\nerrdefer-ran-recovered\nliteral err: <nil>\nct-quiet\nct-quiet\nstart-panic\nct-errdefer-ran\nrecovered ct: late-boom\nerrdefer-ran-goexit\ndone\n\z'

# The ejected run must print the same lines as this native run.
cp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt

logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo

cd out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native-stdout.txt
exec $GOROOT/bin/gofmt -l .
! stdout .
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/errdeferlaterunwind

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"comptime"
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
)

type Pair struct {
	X int
}

var ready = true

func note(s string) {
	fmt.Println(s)
}

func plainSuccess() error {
	errdefer note("plain-errdefer-must-not-run")
	return nil
}

func lifoOrder() error {
	defer note("defer-first")
	defer note("defer-second")
	return nil
}

func laterPanic() (err error) {
	errdefer note("errdefer-ran")
	defer func() { startPanic() }()
	return nil
}

func namedLaterPanic() (err error) {
	errdefer note("named-errdefer-must-not-run")
	defer startPanic()
	return nil
}

func startPanic() {
	note("start-panic")
	panic("late-boom")
}

func resultLiteralPanic() (err error) {
	errdefer note("result-errdefer-must-not-run")
	defer func() int {
		startPanic()
		return 0
	}()
	return nil
}

func deferringLiteralPanic() (err error) {
	errdefer note("deferring-errdefer-must-not-run")
	defer func() {
		defer note("inner-deferred")
		startPanic()
	}()
	return nil
}

func quietLiteral() (err error) {
	errdefer note("quiet-errdefer-must-not-run")
	defer func() {
		note("quiet-literal")
		if ready {
			return
		}
		note("quiet-unreached")
	}()
	return nil
}

func literalRecovers() (err error) {
	errdefer note("errdefer-ran-recovered")
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			note(fmt.Sprint("literal-recovered: ", r))
		}
	}()
	panic("inner-boom")
}

func ctLaterPanic[T any]() (err error) {
	errdefer note("ct-errdefer-ran")
	const if comptime.IsStruct[T]() {
		defer func() { startPanic() }()
	}
	defer func() {
		note("ct-quiet")
	}()
	return nil
}

func goexitCase() error {
	ctx := context.Background()
	go group (ctx, limit = 1) {
		go exitWorker()
	}
	return nil
}

func exitWorker() (err error) {
	errdefer note("errdefer-ran-goexit")
	defer func() { triggerGoexit() }()
	return nil
}

func triggerGoexit() {
	runtime.Goexit()
}

//logos:allow(slop::discarded_error)
func main() {
	if err := plainSuccess(); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("plain err:", err)
	} else {
		fmt.Println("plain ok: cleanup skipped")
	}
	if err := lifoOrder(); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("lifo err:", err)
	}
	func() {
		defer func() { fmt.Println("recovered:", recover()) }()
		_ = laterPanic()
	}()
	func() {
		defer func() { fmt.Println("recovered named:", recover()) }()
		_ = namedLaterPanic()
	}()
	func() {
		defer func() { fmt.Println("recovered result:", recover()) }()
		_ = resultLiteralPanic()
	}()
	func() {
		defer func() { fmt.Println("recovered deferring:", recover()) }()
		_ = deferringLiteralPanic()
	}()
	if err := quietLiteral(); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("quiet err:", err)
	}
	fmt.Println("literal err:", literalRecovers())
	_ = ctLaterPanic[int]()
	func() {
		defer func() { fmt.Println("recovered ct:", recover()) }()
		_ = ctLaterPanic[Pair]()
	}()
	if err := goexitCase(); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("goexit err:", err)
	}
	fmt.Println("done")
}
